response.sql:
WITH source_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(ss.boxy / NULLIF(ss.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS ss
    ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count
  FROM source_stats
),
kept AS (
  SELECT s.avg_ratio, s.record_count, t.avg_record_count
  FROM source_stats AS s
  CROSS JOIN threshold AS t
  WHERE s.record_count > t.avg_record_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_kept_sources_ratio,
  SUM(record_count) AS total_spatial_records,
  AVG(record_count - avg_record_count) AS average_count_excess
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: A ratio with a zero boxz is undefined and is excluded from the average, as are rows with missing boxy or boxz. Source groups with no defined ratios do not contribute to the average of kept sources' ratios.
